caption: The sail of a small boat is let loose in a breeze, and it fills and bellies out to one side.

sa.check: The sail of a small boat is let loose.
It bellies out to one side.
A breeze is visible in other signs.
The release comes first and the filling follows.

pc.expect: The sail bulges away from the wind and flaps when the wind drops.
pc.fail: It bellies toward the wind; or fills in still air; or stays limp in wind.

pc.expect: The cloth fills smoothly and flaps at the edges.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or stretches; or tears.

pc.expect: It bellies to the same side as other wind signs.
pc.fail: It bellies opposite; or flips randomly; or spins.

pc.expect: The sail hangs from the mast when slack.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or hangs sideways with no wind.

pc.expect: One sail and one boat keep their number.
pc.fail: The sail duplicates; or vanishes; or the boat turns into another object.

pc.expect: The sail's colour and the water stay the same.
pc.fail: The sail changes colour; or the boat changes; or the water changes.
